name: Giuseppe Loverde
bio: A young seminarist of the Cathedral of Palermo, where he lived with eleven others in rooms beneath the roof. He showed Wilde over the cathedral daily during the eight days Wilde spent at Palermo in April 1900, and told him he had entered the Church because his father was a poor cook with too many mouths to feed. Wilde gave him a book of devotion and some money. The letter states his age.
bio_note: The age is the first fact about this record, not a footnote to it: the letter states it, and it is the reason the passage is entered by hand rather than through the ordinary pipeline.
